title: Google Drive & Shared Drives Architecture, Permissions & Governance
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (enterprise Google Workspace migration/architecture).

Google Admin console / Cloud Identity and the Microsoft/Entra side authored at exact detail from the vendors' public docs. Third-party and Google-native MIGRATION TOOLS (Google Workspace Migrate, GWMME, BitTitan MigrationWiz, CloudM) are covered at the procedural playbook level — deep tool-console internals, licensing, and support are deferred to each vendor's own documentation, never invented; version-/preview-dependent behavior flagged 'verify for your version'. Gemini features flagged 'verify in your tenant'. Automation is Python (Admin SDK / APIs). No client names. No secrets/keys in code.
hook: Design Drive and Shared Drives so sharing stays under control
problem: Left ungoverned, Google Drive becomes a sprawl of over-shared files and orphaned ownership. This solution designs the Drive & Shared Drives architecture: a Shared Drives taxonomy and naming model, membership/role design, external-sharing and link-sharing policy, target-audience and trust rules, DLP-aligned sharing controls, and ownership/lifecycle governance — so collaboration is easy but data stays where it belongs.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the Drive model: My Drive vs Shared Drives, taxonomy, roles/membership, external + link-sharing policy, target audiences, and governance/lifecycle.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (Workspace tenant + super-admin, groups source of truth, data-classification/DLP policy, stakeholders).

Implementation Guide — define the Shared Drives taxonomy + naming, set membership/role model, configure external/link-sharing + target audiences, align DLP sharing controls, and stand up ownership/lifecycle governance — pilot-first, each drive/policy named.

5 Python tools — assessment/discovery, a configuration or orchestration helper, a validation/report generator, a policy/health check, and a scope/config helper — authentic Google Workspace Admin SDK / API automation (read-only or dry-run by default; no credentials or keys in code).
Validation gates (sharing scoped to policy, no orphaned ownership, governance reporting) plus Best Practices for keeping Drive governed as it grows.
short: Design the Google Drive & Shared Drives architecture — taxonomy, membership/role model, external/link-sharing policy, target audiences, DLP-aligned controls, and ownership/lifecycle governance — so collaboration is easy and data stays controlled. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
